payload.title: Scheduled board snapshot job writing public JSON
payload.description:
As a publication builder, I want a scheduled job that writes the board as JSON, so that a static site can show ranks and counts without live queries.

Snapshot (per week and current): top N items, rank, per-dimension means, n, upvote counts, editor means, derived values, rising (votes in the last 6 hours), new, verdict log. Public-safe by construction: counts and ids only, never private text. Cadence configurable (for example every 5 to 15 minutes). A guest-surface test pins the JSON shape and checks it contains no private fields. Requires an EventBridge-style schedule and a function: needs explicit approval before any AWS resource is created.

```gherkin
Feature: Board snapshot
  Scenario: Snapshot written
    Given items with votes and ratings
    When the snapshot job runs
    Then a board JSON file is written to the site's data path with ranks, means, n and counts

  Scenario: Public-safe
    Then the JSON contains no email addresses, reader ids or private message text

  Scenario: Cadence
    Given a configured cadence
    Then the job runs on that schedule and records the time of the last run
```
